official_source.title: Fractal Audio Systems Blocks Guide
official_source.qualification: Guide covers FM9 family. Firmware v12.0 names FM9 Original and FM9 Turbo, not Mark II Turbo by name; installed firmware is unknown.

completed_checkpoints.documented_controls: Start/Middle/End vowels (AAA, EEE, III, OHH, OOO, EHH, AHH, AWW, UHH, ERR), Resonance, Control; common Mix, Level, Balance, Bypass, and Bypass Mode.
completed_checkpoints.project_controls: The existing generic A/E/I/O/U sweep is retained. Three-vowel mode has Start/Middle/End selectors, manual Control 0–100% with middle at 50%, project-authored profile frequencies/gains, Resonance Q 0.5–12, Mix 0–1, Level −24…+12 dB, Balance −100…+100%, and 10 ms smoothing. Automated LFO/expression modifier assignment and selectable Bypass Mode are not implemented.

verification.isolated_benchmark: 648 B processor state; p50 0.0896%, p95 0.1425%, p99 0.1560%, p99.9 0.9098%, max 1.4400% of 2.667 ms callback at 48 kHz stereo/128 frames; processor-call estimate, not a live device measurement

current_checkpoint.name: HeadRush Prime C-Verb 10-second stereo IR capacity

official_source.title: HeadRush Prime User Guide
official_source.revision: v5.0.0 guide checked for C-Verb details; official downloads page listed v5.2 guide and firmware as current on 2026-11-23
official_source.qualification: C-Verb controls, 10-second maximum, one-instance limit, and first-two-channel rule are documented in the v5.0.0 manual; project ranges and DSP are not HeadRush settings or parity.

current_checkpoint.documented_controls: Preset, Reverb File, High Pass, Low Pass, Wet, and Tails On/Off. The guide documents WAV/AIF/OPUS, first two channels of a multichannel IR, one C-Verb per rig, a 10-second maximum, and CPU use dependent on IR length; it gives no numeric control ranges.
current_checkpoint.project_controls: Existing Reverb row/index 58; local mono/stereo WAV only; project-authored Mix, Wet Level, wet High Pass/Low Pass and Tails; max 480,000 frames at target rate (10 s at 48 kHz); 1,024-frame fixed latency; independent stereo kernels; no bundled IR, AIF/OPUS, multichannel import, or cross-rig spillover.

verification.native_ctest: make test passed: 96/96 CTest cases and 11 audio-fixture safety tests; Convolution Reverb tests cover partition timing, stereo kernels, 10-second acceptance, filters, tails, zero allocation, and offline CLI latency/output
verification.browser: passed with local stereo Guitar-TECHS DI; full 71-stage native/browser comparison max absolute error 0.000006970898652980395 and RMS error 0.0000014077249412678672; C-Verb test loaded/replaced 480,000-frame stereo PCM WAV, checked separate L/R output (0.25/0.125), 1,024-frame latency, Reverb category, worklet guard, and 64 MiB heap
verification.isolated_benchmark: 15,461,240 B maximum stereo processor state; Ryzen 9 5950X at 48 kHz stereo/128 frames: p50 0.0382%, p95 79.4286%, p99 92.2945%, p99.9 108.1668%, max 130.4420% of 2.667 ms callback; occasional deadline overruns mean glitch-free real-time use is not established
verification.audio_regression: passed using existing local fixtures: five EGFxSet pickup positions; 3,480,000-frame Guitar-TECHS stereo DI and mono fold-down; full 70-stage chain includes Convolution Reverb; separate Tape Echo, Multi-head Echo, Three-Stage Distortion, Stereo Crossover, and Asheville Pattrn renders passed
verification.notes: Project-authored convolution/control values; not HeadRush DSP/settings parity. No hardware listening or live-route performance check.
